venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.weather: Rainy and overcast till 7pm; heat advisory 8am-6pm
venues.narrative: **CC ATL — Monday 7/27.** MOD MKZ. Net $811 vs target $884 (-8.3%); food $164; comps $49.55 (emp discount, industry, O4W, F&F). 33 guests, $24.58 check avg (reported 27.86). Hot humid start; 9 groups in for Meal Deal — busier Monday than last week, uptick after local influencer feature. Lull 7-8pm, industry pop ~10pm; Casi Cielo crew in. FOH/BOH tackled cleaning projects. Kitchen: smooth; ServSafe cert push by month-end. 86: Classic City, High Noons. Maintenance: backbar cooler gaskets — parts ordered, awaiting delivery. (Report typed 7/28 but day-of-week Monday, posted 12:12am 7/28 — matched to 7/27 by post time.)

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Monday 7/27.** MOD KE. Net $760 vs target $1,138 (-33.2%); food $0; comps $20.85 (2.74%). 31 guests, $24.51 check avg. Disappointing sales but productive day, excellent guests — four dates going at once at one point (venue increasingly a 'hidden gem' date spot), a birthday, out-of-towners. Maintenance: kitchen flood. Favorite: first-date couple bonded over pickled onions, 3-hour date.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 7/27.** MOD Thomas; Chef Kyler. Net $3,344 vs target $4,177 (-19.9%); beverage $3,010, food $194, retail $140; comps $34. 98 covers, 2 large parties, 7 solos. First seating dominated by seniors on a one-drink cocktail tour, then a chill flow; ~half full most of the night, rail seated ~10pm, quiet streets after 11pm. 4 birthdays and a honeymoon; two Denver guests visiting 'the mothership.' Top sellers: chips & dip, Rosalie, Native Lion. 2 no-shows, not charged. Menu count 18/19; breakage: water glass, Collins, SOF.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 7/27.** MOD Mikey, Vic & Joshua. Net $3,560 vs target $4,772 (-25.4%), all Marquee (SR closed); food $965; comps $120 (investors/members, industry, employee discounts). 101 guests. Bar top filled fast, floor tables filled in through the night; easy-going service, never overwhelming. Investors in (incl. the magician); Griffin by for oysters; Caitlin visited for her and Mikey's 13-year anniversary. Early, smooth close. Low: fried chicken (3ct), Highland Park Hazy IPA (new keg due 7/28).

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Monday 7/27.** MOD Josh. Net $2,632.19 vs target $2,949 (-10.7%); Marquee gross $3,502.23, Garden closed; food $237; comps $51.78 (1.9%), voids $65 (2.4%). 41 guests. Slow night at the 124: decent start, tapered after first hour (host cut ~8pm), then foot traffic rebuilt to ~75% full by close with industry guests, two-tops and an 8-top. Smooth service, strong comms. Michael, Meghan, Cory and Marcus all in the building. Maintenance: same as prior.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 7/27.** AM MOD Sam & Marcus; PM Justin & Marcus. Net $3,685 vs target $4,500 (-18.1%); Municipal AM $1,011 (30 guests), PM $2,157 (75 guests), Sun Club $32, Hot Eye $0; food $1,718; comps $218.21 (incl. DNLs on oysters and an overdressed flatbread). Homes & Parties photo shoot on site 7am-6pm with a big footprint. Quiet morning and night; busiest hour 6:30-7:30pm; host cut at 8pm. Good industry presence. Sun Club closed early for lightning. Kitchen slow; tossed half bag expired oysters. Rowdy teens on Broughton briefly disturbed hotel guests 10:30-10:45pm (inaudible inside).
